convention: groups qkv/o/gateup/down; importance mean|x| over calibration tokens (o: also over the query heads of each KV head); s=clamp(imp^alpha, min=1e-4)/sqrt(max*min); alpha grid 0..0.95 step 0.05; loss = summed squared output error of the group's projections on dense calibration inputs with original weights; argmin, ties to the lower alpha; folds: input_layernorm/=s_qkv, v rows and bias/=s_o, post_attention_layernorm/=s_gateup, up rows/=s_down, consumer columns*=s; no clipping search
